title: NeoPixel Power Budget
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: Click pixels on a virtual NeoPixel strip and choose the color, length, and brightness while a gauge compares the total current with the 500 mA USB limit.

learningObjectives: Calculate the current a NeoPixel design draws
Evaluate whether a design needs an external 5 V supply

keyQuestions: How much current does full white draw per pixel?
When does a strip need its own power supply?
commonMisconceptions: Any strip can run from USB
assessmentOpportunities: Compute the current of 30 white pixels at 50 percent
Decide whether a 450 mA design is safe on USB
